description: Prepare an expiring, actor-bound intent without placing an order or debiting money. For products that need an inquiry this call runs the inquiry itself (no separate inquire_purchase needed). For identities WITHOUT an account (anonymous agents) buyer_name is REQUIRED; buyer_phone and buyer_email are optional and must never be demanded from the user. An account-bound identity buys as its account and needs none of them. An anonymous order is paid through the payment link returned by execute_purchase: give that link to the buyer and tell them fulfilment starts after payment. Show the returned destination, customer name (if any), product and amount to the user. Products with open_denom need amount (nominal typed by the buyer, min 1000); products with needs_inquiry need the inquiry_id returned by inquire_purchase for the same destination and amount. Fixed-price products in some groups return their native checkout form. The result carries a policy block: how long the intent is valid (expires_at, about 5 minutes), how many renewals remain, and the per-order and hourly limits of this identity. An order refused for a limit is final: do not split it, retry it or look for a way around it; tell the buyer plainly.
name: prepare_purchase
title: Siapkan pesanan (belum dibayar)
